skill_friction: The 'two wrong AskCoworker claims' threshold is hard to count: it is unclear whether AskCoworker's statements about its own tool limits (e.g. 'ValidationRule not queryable via SOQL', 'flow bodies not retrievable', 'default value not queryable') count as wrong platform claims or as Unknowns. I counted ValidationRule plus the TODAY()-default claim in I.

SKILL.md says 'Skip D2 only if D1 already answered its questions' but D1 answered most of D2 (triggers, flows, writers); no guidance on whether a partial overlap justifies a narrower D2. I sent full D2.

The R template regularly times out; the retry rule says split or narrow, but it is unclear whether runtime ordering then must get its own follow-up call or can be covered by documented platform behavior. I covered it with platform behavior plus org queries and noted it in Section 8.

Spec format says to use Flow Tests for flow-only changes, but T returned Apex-style test methods inside a FlowTest; there is no guidance on how many FlowTest components to create for multiple scenarios (one per scenario vs one main-outcome test). I kept one FlowTest and moved the rest to manual checks.
RUNNER says scratch files go in {out}/.tmp while org-verification.md says design/.tmp; followed the eval note.
